Definition: Jakin, the name of three Israelites and of a temple pillar
BiblicalUsage: Jachin is the name of a priestly family in Jerusalem, and also the name Solomon gave to the right-hand pillar of the temple porch. The pillar stood beside its fellow Boaz, and the name means He shall establish, a promise set in bronze at the door of God's house. Three lines of priests carried the name, and the pillar carried it before every worshipper who entered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God establishes what He builds, and He wrote that promise on the pillar at His own door. When I enter His presence, I stand under a name that says He will establish me too.
